title: error_status(): wildcard maps unknown error types to 400 not 500
description: kith-jmap/src/lib.rs:59 — the match on error_type falls through to _ => StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST for any unknown error type string. If a new error variant is added with server-fault semantics, it silently returns 400 (Bad Request), telling clients to retry with a different request rather than 500 (Internal Server Error), which signals a server bug. Should default to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR or be exhaustive with a compile-time check.
